Hello Mrs Zahra,

Thank you for your message, and I hope you're having a great day as well.

We sincerely apologize for the confusion caused by our previous communication.

As mentioned earlier, your security deposit refund will be processed within 7 working days after your check-out, provided the apartment is returned in accordance with the terms and conditions.

Please disregard the 7–14 working days mentioned previously, as that was an error on our part.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your understanding. If you have any further questions, please feel free to let us know.

Thank you.
